P001.text:
The deterministic rule engine produced 1 finding (1 HIGH) with an overall result of HIGH. This explanation restates those results only; it does not add findings or change severity.

Observed data: the structured record lists an active order for Lisinopril (RxNorm 29046, 20 mg once daily) and a result of Potassium 5.8 mmol/L on 2026-09-17 (flagged high). Rule interpretation: rule DL-001 classifies this as HIGH because the result is above the configured threshold of 5.7 mmol/L. Elevated potassium is a medication-safety concern in a patient receiving lisinopril. Supporting evidence: EVID-002 (DailyMed / FDA drug labeling).
